name: Of Love and…
source:
“Do you love me?”

A question that, at the time, seemed like a good idea. But Dewi, who is being asked, answers with absolute resolve: “No.”

‘Of Love and You’ is a story about two teenagers, whose relationship is that of close friends, good buddies and, to some, of lovers. Dewi, who enjoys punching the narrator. The narrator, who insists his relation with Dewi is entirely pure and devoid of love. But is love such an explosive emotion, such fierce passion that one experiences? Or is it a dull, normal day spent with one where you feel entirely at ease with?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170318200555/http://www.iihigate.eu/of-love-and-you/]The Official Site[/url]]
